summary: SEND-144 frontend verification on EST-176308 (338c6ac8-4e77-4dcd-84df-1cb7327b7ecb) — ALL 9 ACCEPTANCE POINTS PASS. The `ai-measure-read-photos` strip is present in the AI Measure PREVIEW tab after RESTORE PREVIEW, with EIGHT buttons `ai-measure-read-photo-takeoff-0..7` labelled with the read's OWN elevation calls (FRONT, FRONT-LEFT, LEFT, REAR-LEFT, BACK, REAR-RIGHT, RIGHT, FRONT-RIGHT). Each button opens the Photo Takeoff editor on the read's own ai_*.jpg file, so the zones are on the same file the read read. On FRONT, the editor shows the STAGE 2 — AFTER AI banner and SIX provisional marks (AI front body, AI front gable, 4 AI openings), the body basis carries all seven required substrings ('27.0 ft × 10.9 ft', 'width direct_ref', 'confidence 70', 'starting position', 'NOT a measurement', '10.9 ft vs 9.0 ft', 'NOT averaged'), the gable basis carries 'RISE of 6.5 ft' + 'NOT derived from a pitch'; candidate edges render pure words only (starter candidate / corner candidate ×2 / eave / frieze candidate); the STARTING ZONES button is ENABLED and a second press keeps mark count at 6 (idempotent, toast confirms 'this read's starting zones are already here; nothing was overwritten'). On RIGHT, the button opens the RIGHT ai photo and STARTING ZONES refuses with the run's own words ('RIGHT — no photo measured this wall's width (assumed_symmetric). Not measured. Not copied from another face. — no body zone, no gable zone, no dormer zone') placing NO marks. On FRONT-LEFT the button refuses with 'the read calls this photo a FRONT-LEFT shot — a corner shot is NOT a fifth wall: it shows two faces foreshortened and the read measured neither plane here. Zones land on a face's own head-on photo' and places no marks. On LEFT the editor shows 7 marks including AI left body ('37.0 ft × 8.4 ft', 'direct_ref', 'direct_consensus', 'confidence 82') and AI left dormer whose basis contains 'UNANCHORED: Dormer on the left slope reports 14.1 ft wide but NO reference marker was in frame'. Trim rows on FRONT ('Linear runs — confirmed marks only') all print em-dash refusals — nothing was overwritten or deducted. NOTHING WAS DELETED, CONFIRMED, APPLIED, OR RE-SCALED — the zones stay in place per Howard's rule. EST-886440 was not touched.
